name: i Cubed Systems,Inc.
summary: i3 Systems, Inc., headquartered in Fukuoka, Japan, and formed in 2001, supplies mobile device management solutions on the cloud in Japan. Its CLOMO product family includes SecuredBrowser, which lets smart devices browse the web securely, SecuredMailer, an email client that guards against data leakage, and SecuredCalendar for group schedule sharing. It supports businesses, educational institutions and healthcare organizations.
